method: Original-facet cross normals; start 1e-5mm outside. Full positive Moller-Trumbore hits via independent C++ BVH, no skipped first segment, deduplicate 1e-7mm. Four parity controls use independent oblique rays: inward close point, outward origin, first-solid midpoint, immediate post-exit. Short first intervals retained even when a later wall is thick. Selected all-triangle numpy verification.
limitations: Finite original triangle samples, not a global minimum-thickness proof. Normal short chords at lips/corners and grooves require geometric classification; a count below 0.8 is not alone proof of an unsupported wall. Control failures and near numerical-resolution segments are reported, not counted as safe.
